current.text: Signed with Detroit for 3 years and 27 million USD.
An expert does not understand the deal. He thinks Huerter could be used as a shooter next to Isaiah Joe.

He is not in Detroit's projected starting five. In the projected bench order, Isaiah Joe is the sixth man, then Ron Holland, Paul Reed and Daniss Jenkins. Huerter or Prince gets the last rotation spot.
Last season Detroit used a deep 12 to 13 player rotation that limited everyone's minutes.
Experts say coach J.B. Bickerstaff cannot be trusted on what he says about minutes.
Detroit plays 4, 3 and 4 games in our playoff weeks 19 to 21 and has 15 back-to-backs this season.
